title: selaginella plumosa f. tetragonostachya
intro: Selaginella plumosa f. tetragonostachya, commonly known as Spike Moss, is a type of flowering plant in the family Selaginellaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit microbial growth, and exhibit expectorant properties, making it useful in treating coughs and bronchitis. Bioactive constituents present in Selaginella plumosa f. tetragonostachya include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
